sloka: बहु प्रकारैर् विविधैर् वर सम्स्कार सम्स्कृतैः ।माम्सैः कुशल सम्युक्तैः पान भूमि गतैः पृथक् ॥५-११-१९॥
transliteration: bahu prakārair vividhair vara samskāra samskṛtaiḥ ।māmsaiḥ kuśala samyuktaiḥ pāna bhūmi gataiḥ pṛthak ॥5-11-19॥

translations.english: In the banquet hall there were many types of meat arranged in a number of ways. They were cooked by experts by seasoning them with choicest ingredients.
